note: Every external dataset the site uses or quotes. 'role' says how: 'data' is loaded by the app, 'reference' is a published figure the model starts from, 'basis' is a document the team's model follows, 'image' is shown as a picture. A null product_id carries a 'verify' note instead of a guessed identifier.

region.name: Melas Chasma, north wall
region.projection: Equirectangular on a sphere of radius 3,396,190 m; standard parallel 8.83 S, central meridian 287.39 E

tiles.format: Float32, little-endian, row-major, north row first
tiles.resampling: gdalwarp, bilinear, from the source grid (200 m) to the local equirectangular grid (200 m); the app then interpolates to 40 m cells (Catmull-Rom)

datasets.name: Mars MGS MOLA - MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200m v2
datasets.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (MOLA: NASA Goddard, Mars Global Surveyor; HRSC: DLR, ESA Mars Express)
datasets.units: m above the areoid, 200 m per pixel
datasets.license: MOLA: CC0. HRSC: CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
datasets.citation: Fergason, R. L., Hare, T. M., & Laura, J. (2018). HRSC and MOLA Blended Digital Elevation Model at 200m v2. Astrogeology PDS Annex, U.S. Geological Survey.
datasets.used_for: Elevation of every map cell; slope, sky view, safety classes and routes are computed from it

datasets.name: Mars Science Laboratory Radiation Assessment Detector (RAD), surface dose rate
datasets.verify: PDS data set identifier of the RAD reduced data records was not checked by the team
datasets.units: 0.64 mSv/day (= 26.7 microSv/h), average at Gale crater, 2012-2013, near solar maximum
datasets.citation: Hassler, D. M., et al. (2014). Mars' surface radiation environment measured with the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity rover. Science, 343(6169), 1244797.
datasets.used_for: One reference dose rate, scaled by a sky-view factor from the DEM. Not measured in Valles Marineris

datasets.name: THEMIS Thermal Inertia Mosaic, Quantitative, 100 m
datasets.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / Arizona State University (2001 Mars Odyssey THEMIS)
datasets.verify: No THEMIS tile is bundled. The quadrangle file that covers 8.83 S, 287.39 E was not retrieved; the USGS download host did not answer when the tile was cut
datasets.units: J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2 (TIU), stated accuracy about 20%
datasets.citation: Fergason, R. L., Christensen, P. R., & Kieffer, H. H. (2006). High-resolution thermal inertia derived from THEMIS: Thermal model and applications. J. Geophys. Res., 111, E12004. doi:10.1029/2006JE002735
datasets.used_for: Not loaded. The model uses one regolith reference value (295 TIU) for every cell and says so

datasets.name: Human Integration Design Handbook (HIDH), Revision 1
datasets.verify: The exact HIDH table for oxygen use against metabolic rate was not checked by the team
datasets.units: metabolic rate (W, MET) and oxygen use (L/min)
datasets.citation: NASA (2014). Human Integration Design Handbook, NASA/SP-2010-3407/REV1.
datasets.used_for: Basis of the team's oxygen model. The coefficients are the team's, not NASA values

datasets.name: HiRISE images of Valles Marineris landforms
datasets.provider: NASA / JPL-Caltech / University of Arizona (Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter HiRISE)
datasets.units: images, about 25 cm per pixel at full resolution
datasets.citation: McEwen, A. S., et al. (2007). Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter's High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE). J. Geophys. Res., 112, E05S02.
datasets.used_for: Pictures of the same kind of ground. Not pictures of the mapped spot
